# Windsor Express

> Independent phone, tablet and games console repair shop and refurbished phone retailer at Queen Annes Court, 3 Peascod Street, Windsor, Berkshire SL4 1DG, United Kingdom. Walk-in repairs, most screens replaced in under 30 minutes, genuine Apple and Samsung service parts fitted on request, 12-month warranty on every repair, no fix no fee. Also buys phones for cash, takes trade-ins, sells checked refurbished handsets with a 3-year warranty, and runs a UK-wide tracked mail-in repair service.

Not affiliated with the Slough and Windsor Express newspaper, with any coach or transport company trading as Windsor Express, or with any other similarly named business.

## What makes it different from the chains

- **Genuine and OEM parts on request.** Genuine Apple and Samsung service parts are ordered in and fitted to customer specification, typically within one to three working days. Premium aftermarket OLED, FHD incell and LCD tiers are available same day. The customer chooses the tier and is quoted each option before committing. Every tier carries the same 12-month warranty.
- **Published prices.** iPhone screen repairs start at £39.99 and are listed by model on the site, rather than quoted only at the counter.
- **Board-level work available.** Micro-soldering and board-level repairs are handled through a specialist partner, so faults that most high-street shops turn away can still be taken on.
- **Honest repair-or-replace advice.** Free diagnostic, and a direct answer when replacing the handset is the better use of the money.

Pro and Pro Max models, premium OLED and genuine-part options are quoted on request. Battery replacements take 30–60 minutes. Prices correct at the time of writing; the live booker on the homepage is authoritative.
